ios.desc:
IDENTIFYING HISTORICAL ARTIFACTS HAS NEVER BEEN THIS EASY

Turn your camera into a powerful history guide with History Identifier. Thanks to our artificial intelligence technology, instantly identify the historical artifact in front of you, learn detailed information, and listen to it out loud! 

   INSTANT SCANNING

Point your camera at any historical building, monument, or museum object - our AI technology will identify it within seconds.

   YOUR AUDIO GUIDE

Take your eyes off the screen, discover history with your ears! Listen to AI explanations in 13 different languages.

   YOUR PERSONAL MUSEUM

Save all the historical artifacts you visit and create your own digital collection.

   FEATURES:
- Advanced AI recognition technology
- Audio guide support in 13 languages
- Personal collection saving
- Detailed historical information
- Regular content updates

Download now and start exploring the past!
